content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows users to deploy websites directly from a GitHub repository. This service is ideal for digital creators who want to sell products such as ebooks or online courses without incurring high fees from traditional platforms. By using GitHub Pages, you can create a fully functional online store that operates independently of conventional payment gateways. This is particularly significant in regions where access to these platforms is limited, as it provides an alternative that ensures you maintain full control over your sales and customer data. This level of sovereignty not only empowers creators but also enhances their ability to monetize their digital offerings effectively.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a digital store built on GitHub Pages involves several key components working in unison. At its core, GitHub Pages hosts your website, while Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers manage backend operations such as processing orders and handling product delivery. For payment processing, NOWPayments enables you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees and no KYC requirements. This combination creates a seamless experience where customers can make purchases and receive instant digital deliveries without relying on traditional payment processors. The use of these technologies not only ensures that you can operate independently but also allows for scalability as your business grows.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or unreliable, such as Nigeria, Ghana, or Venezuela. These creators often sell digital products like courses, templates, and software but struggle to collect payments due to local restrictions. The solution provided by GitHub Pages, in conjunction with NOWPayments, allows them to establish a reliable online store that minimizes transaction costs and maximizes profit retention. This architecture is not just a workaround; it represents a sustainable way to build a digital commerce ecosystem that is resilient against the challenges posed by financial isolation.
GitHub Pages allows you to create a free and resilient digital storefront.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The digital product store on GitHub Pages is composed of several interlinked components. Firstly, GitHub Pages serves as the hosting platform for your product website. Next, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle the backend processes, allowing for smooth order management and file delivery. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly to provide a low-cost payment processing solution, enabling customers to pay in cryptocurrency. Finally, storage solutions such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 are utilized for hosting product files, ensuring rapid delivery upon purchase. Together, these components create a cohesive infrastructure that empowers creators to run their businesses without reliance on third-party platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital store using GitHub Pages, start by setting up a GitHub account and creating a new repository for your site. Next, create an HTML file that showcases your products and links to relevant payment options through NOWPayments. For backend functionality, set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage order processing and delivery. Store your digital files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and link them in your site. Finally, test your setup thoroughly to ensure everything works seamlessly before launching it to the public. This straightforward approach allows you to establish a fully functional online store within a short timeframe.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing platforms like GitHub Pages combined with NOWPayments for payment processing. This approach allows you to create a digital storefront where you retain full control over your sales and transaction costs. By avoiding traditional payment processors, you can significantly reduce fees and ensure a smoother purchasing experience for your customers.
NOWPayments offers low transaction fees, keeping more money in your pocket.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your store. 2. Develop an engaging HTML page that displays your digital products. 3. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. 4. Set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend order management. 5. Store your product files in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. 6. Test the entire system to ensure everything operates smoothly before launching.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by leveraging GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency payments directly.

NOWPayments charges a transaction fee of only 0.5%, which is significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad that charge 10%. This allows you to retain more earnings from your sales.
